dct_title_s: Sea Surface Temperature (L3, Night, Annual, Mid Infrared, 9 km), Aqua / MODIS
dct_description_sm: The MODIS L3 SST 9km layer shows global nighttime sea surface temperature (SST) at a depth of a few micrometers with ranges from -1.8 to 32 degree Celsius. The SST is derived with a Mid-Infrared (Short–Wave) SST Algorithm that uses MODIS bands 22 and 23 at 3.959 and 4.050 μm. This Level 3 product is derived from native 1 km Level 2 SST observations that are mapped to a global 9 km grid. The temporal resolution of this MODIS L3 SST is annual.

P. J. Minnett et al., "Sea-surface temperature measurements from the Moderate-Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) on Aqua and Terra," IGARSS 2004. 2004 IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium, Anchorage, AK, 2004, pp. 4576-4579 vol.7. doi: 10.1109/IGARSS.2004.1370173.

A yearly visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), covering 2002-01-01 to 2021-01-01. Made from MODIS Aqua Level 3 SST MID-IR Annual 9km Nighttime V2019.0 (MODIS_AQUA_L3_SST_MID-IR_ANNUAL_9KM_NIGHTTIME_V2019.0, version 2019.0, doi:10.5067/MODAM-AN9N9).
